title: Sorting people
description:
Sort a list of people several ways with `Comparable` and `Comparator`.

```
Natural order (last name): Hopper, Lovelace, Turing
By age, oldest first: Hopper 85, Turing 41, Lovelace 36
By first name length, then name: Ada, Alan, Grace
```
hints: `new ArrayList<>(people)` makes a copy you can sort; `List.of` itself cannot be changed.
requirements: `record Person(String first, String last, int age) implements Comparable<Person>` comparing last names.
Do not change the original list (sort copies).
stretch: Sort by a key the user types (`age`, `first`, `last`), chosen from a `Map<String, Comparator<Person>>`.
